Generate Local Evidence · Grade 1
Optional and off by default. Creates a device-signed, hash-verifiable record of this attempt after the session. It proves tamper-evidence from this browser device; it does not prove identity, an organisation attestation, or a trusted timestamp. A device signing key is stored locally only if you opt in.

Content mapped to and under rolling legal review against Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744. General pool: 161 questions, grounded in the 120-card Daily Audit Tasting library. Manager/Compliance/Technical tracks add a separate, harder layer on top. Sector pool: 194 questions across 12 tracks — scenario groupings tested against use-case and legal-trigger analysis, not industry labels — designed as a companion to the general foundation, accessible any time via ?type=sector. Pulse, onboarding, 6-month deep-dive and annual exam cadences.

Exam mode — fixed question set for this year, feedback withheld until the end. 80% is EACE's internal assessment benchmark, not a regulatory threshold.

This is a self-reported completion receipt, not an auditable evidence record. Copy it and send it to HR/IT via your internal channel — it encodes name, score, date, focus area and an attempt ID, nothing else, and is decoded locally by EACE's admin tool, never transmitted by this page. If you also opted into Evidence Mode below, that record shares the same attempt ID, so the two can be shown to correlate to the same session without either one carrying the other's payload. If you choose to copy, print or send this receipt, that subsequent handling happens outside this local module and is governed by your organisation's own processes.
